The Cyclones were led by [[T. J. Otzelberger]] in his fourth season as head coach. They played their home games at [[Hilton Coliseum]] in [[Ames, Iowa]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. On January 13, the Cyclones reached #2 in the AP Poll, which was the highest ranking in program history. The Iowa State Cyclones drew an average home attendance of 14,062, the 17th-highest of all college basketball teams.https://stats.ncaa.org/rankings/change_sport_year_div ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Cyclones]] started the season 11–2 in non-conference play. They finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 29–8, 13–5 in [[2023–24 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in second place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2024 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], they defeated the No. 10 seed [[2023–24 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]], No. 3 seed [[2023–24 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]] and No. 1 seed [[2023–24 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] to win their sixth Big 12 tournament title and receive the conference's automatic bid into the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. The received a 2 seed in the East region. The defeated 15 seed [[2023–24 South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball team|South Dakota State]], No. 7 seed [[2023–24 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] before losing to No. 3 seed [[2023–24 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] in the Sweet Sixteen, 72–69. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center" ! colspan=3 style="{{CollegePrimaryStyle|Iowa State Cyclones|border=0}}" |Offseason Departures |- {{CollegeSecondaryHeader|team=Iowa State Cyclones|Name|Position|Reason}} |- |Tre King |F |Exhausted eligibility. |- |[[Hason Ward]] |F |Exhausted eligibility. |- |Robert Jones |F |Exhausted eligibility. |} ===Incoming transfers=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center" ! colspan=6 style="{{CollegePrimaryStyle|Iowa State Cyclones|border=0}}" |Incoming transfers |- {{CollegeSecondaryHeader|team=Iowa State Cyclones|Name|Position|Hometown|Previous
